verdict.rationale: The evidence points to some event-driven automation. Users can build and edit ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts in the AI Editor, external systems can push data in through webhooks, and continuous monitoring raises alerts. However, nothing documents a general rule engine where users define event-to-action triggers; most automation is described as pre-mapped controls and workflows. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined trigger/condition/action rule builder, a list of supported events and actions, outbound or action-triggering webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
